values.title: Auth session format
values.body:
Session tokens now use the v2 format. Existing sessions keep working until they expire, and new sessions are issued in the new format.

## Migration notes

- Custom code that decodes tokens should read the `sub` and `exp` claims from the new payload.

- The public key set is available at the same JWKS endpoint.

- Set `sessionFormat: "v1"` in `tessera.config.ts` to delay the switch by one release.
